gm.motif: 3x3x2 rocksalt slab minus one corner MgO pair (16 planar Mg2O2 4-rings, no 6-rings); Mg and O CN 3(x5),4(x2),5(x1); Mg-O 1.941-2.313 A, O-O >= 2.81 A, Mg-Mg >= 2.78 A (across 4-rings)
gm.literature: IR-UV spectroscopy + DFT GA (Haertelt et al., PCCP 14, 2849 (2012)): (MgO)3k hexagonal tubes, n != 3k cage-like structures with hexagonal (MgO)3 rings; only (MgO)4 bulk-like

notes: NEP89 favours rocksalt fragments for (MgO)8 (GM 0.25 eV below the 2x2x4 cuboid; hand-built hexagonal-ring cage +2.7 eV) unlike DFT/IR; structure is chemically sensible (no O-O, Mg-Mg bonds). Final budget 7000 = 3 x BH median hit 2340 (BH SR 0.8, RS SR 0.2 at 7000). All same-structure GM energies within 1 meV -> e_tol 0.02.

bulk_reference_nep89.verdict: cluster less stable than bulk (no NEP89-hole signature)
